hero.fixed_paragraph: Inspired by the limulus — a creature whose layered vision bridges ancient biology and modern optics — I explore how light, perception, and computation shape the interfaces of tomorrow. My work spans augmented reality, computer vision, generative AI, and mobile development, driven by a curiosity that turns experiments into projects and ideas into prototypes. Whether studying how systems perceive the world or how users interact with it, I approach technology as a living laboratory, where every domain is an opportunity to learn, build, and discover new ways to extend reality.
